bio: Located close to the marina, this restaurant with a minimalist, contemporary feel has been serving customers now for over two decades (this strong work ethic is to an extent encapsulated by its name which is the Spanish word for “honeycomb”). The couple in charge, Xavier and Alba, conjure up an updated take on traditional cuisine on an à la carte and three menus: the daily “El del día” (available for lunch midweek), Arròs, and Bresca. We particularly enjoyed the crispy pigs’ trotters with black botifarra sausage....
